statusSettlement.gatewaySettlementLeaves.source: Gateway settlement leaves no per-payment explorer hash. Keryx compares the payout ledger with observed Circle balances for each payee and publishes both numbers. A wallet holding {emphasis} than Keryx accounts for belongs to that payee and never flags; one holding less is read against its on-chain balance first, because a payee may cash out by any route they like.
statusSettlement.gatewaySettlementLeaves.text: Gateway 结算不产生每笔付款的浏览器哈希。Keryx 将付款账本与逐收款人观察的 Circle 余额比较，并公布两者。钱包持有金额{emphasis} Keryx 账目时，差额归收款人且不标记；低于账目时先查看链上余额，因为收款人可通过任意方式提现。

statusReconciliation.acceptedTransfersSe.source: Accepted transfers settle only on an exact tuple. Circle-terminal failures close without earnings and release capacity only for the same grant generation. Missing or conflicting evidence stays pending. A reviewed legacy treasury ambiguity may be acknowledged to stop a permanent readiness alert, but remains pending, outside earnings, and under reconciliation. Browser reservations can never use this acknowledgement path. Expiry is operational context, never proof that Circle failed or that a browser reservation can be released.
statusReconciliation.acceptedTransfersSe.text: 已接受转账仅在精确元组匹配时结算。Circle 终态失败关闭且不产生收益，仅为相同授权代次释放容量。缺失或冲突证据仍待处理。经审核的旧金库歧义可确认以停止永久就绪提醒，但仍待处理、不计收益且继续对账。浏览器预留不能使用此确认路径。过期仅是运营背景，绝不证明 Circle 失败或可释放浏览器预留。
